visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An old color photograph from 1990 shows a young woman with permed hair leaning against a red Honda sedan. She wears a blue sweatshirt and high-waisted dark jeans, standing under a corrugated metal roof with a brick wall behind her. (2) In a 2025 shot, the same woman, now older, holds the old photo in front of a modern black SUV. She is smiling, wearing a navy 'KORS' sweatshirt and blue jeans. (3) A 2004 photo captures three women and a young boy outdoors near a lake. The woman from the previous scene is in the center, smiling widely. (4) Transition to 2025, showing the same group in an indoor setting. The boy is now a young man with glasses making a silly face, and they are joined by an elderly woman. (5) A 2005 photo shows the elderly woman holding a baby. The photo is slightly grainy with typical early-2000s lighting. (6) In 2025, the elderly woman and the grown-up baby (now a young woman) pose together on a couch, smiling warmly at the camera. (7) A 1993 photo depicts a woman with glasses working behind a counter in what appears to be a small convenience store or pharmacy, surrounded by shelved products. (8) In 2025, the same woman is seen in a classroom environment, looking surprised and then smiling. She wears glasses and a black hoodie. (9) A 1987 photo shows a group of children and women sitting together in a rustic setting with brick walls. (10) The final 2025 shot shows the woman from the 1987 photo smiling radiantly in a brightly lit indoor room, wearing the same 'KORS' navy sweatshirt.
